name: ai-crawler-readiness-auditor
description: Check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI crawlers can read your website: robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, meta tags and structured data for one public page, with fixes ranked by priority. By ASTUDIO.
keywords: is my website visible to ChatGPT

interface.shortDescription: Is my site visible to AI bots
interface.longDescription: Check one public HTTPS page and its site-level crawler controls. The app reviews effective robots.txt rules for the requested path, response and page directives, sitemap availability, llms.txt file validity, metadata, and JSON-LD parsing. It returns evidence and prioritized remediation choices. It does not access signed-in pages, modify websites, measure AI-answer rankings, compare competitors, or guarantee inclusion, citations, traffic, or ranking in any AI product.
capabilities: Check robots.txt rules for AI crawlers such as GPTBot and OAI-SearchBot
Check page meta tags and directives
Evidence with fixes ranked by priority
One public page per audit, your confirmation first
defaultPrompt: Is my website visible to ChatGPT? Audit https://example.com.
Check robots.txt, sitemap and llms.txt for AI crawlers on https://example.com.
Review the structured data and meta tags on this page for AI search.

positive.description: Audit a standard public page and show a checkpoint before evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the exact target and scope checkpoint, then return passing technical evidence without ranking or inclusion claims.

positive.description: Report an effective robots restriction for the requested path.
positive.expected_behavior: Report effective disallow evidence for the requested path and provide a selectable remediation item.

positive.description: Detect a false llms.txt success response.
positive.expected_behavior: Detect that llms.txt serves HTML or a homepage response instead of a valid text file.

positive.description: Retain completed evidence while warning about malformed structured data.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the malformed JSON-LD block while retaining evidence for checks that completed.

positive.description: Show partial results and continue from an explicit remediation selection.
positive.prompt: Audit https://fixtures.astudio.agency/sitemap-timeout/page and help me choose what to fix.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a clearly labeled incomplete or partial result, show remediation choices, and continue only from selected IDs.

negative.description: A private-network target should be rejected before any connection.
A ranking comparison should not activate because rankings and competitor analysis are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Compare my AI ranking with three competitors and tell me who wins.

negative.description: An authenticated modification request should not activate or request credentials.
negative.prompt: Log into my CMS and update robots.txt based on your audit.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, call paid APIs, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial local release with a human-confirmed checkpoint, bounded public-web checks, evidence, selectable remediation guidance, and MCP Apps widgets.
